items.label: Founder count
items.description: Placeholder. How many people spawn near the world center at the start of a new game.

items.label: Founder age min
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's (including the Advisor's) lowest possible starting age, in years.

items.label: Founder age max
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's (including the Advisor's) highest possible starting age, in years.

items.label: Founder core trade min
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's lowest possible value in a core trade skill (Logging, Quarrying, Farming, Foraging, Hauling, Construction).

items.label: Founder core trade max
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's highest possible value in a core trade skill.

items.label: Founder specialty min
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's lowest possible value in their one random specialty skill (picked from the non-core-trade skills).

items.label: Founder specialty max
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's highest possible value in their specialty skill.

items.label: Founder other skill min
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's lowest possible value in every skill that isn't a core trade or their specialty.

items.label: Founder other skill max
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's highest possible value in every skill that isn't a core trade or their specialty.

items.label: Founder attribute min
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's lowest possible value in every attribute.

items.label: Founder attribute max
items.description: Placeholder. A founder's highest possible value in every attribute.

items.label: Monarch age min
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's lowest possible starting age, in years.

items.label: Monarch age max
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's highest possible starting age, in years.

items.label: Monarch leadership/speech min
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's lowest possible value in Leadership and Speech.

items.label: Monarch leadership/speech max
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's highest possible value in Leadership and Speech.

items.label: Monarch other skill min
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's lowest possible value in every skill other than Leadership and Speech.

items.label: Monarch other skill max
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's highest possible value in every skill other than Leadership and Speech.

items.label: Monarch attribute min
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's lowest possible value in every attribute.

items.label: Monarch attribute max
items.description: Placeholder. The Monarch's highest possible value in every attribute.

items.label: Walk speed
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R10). How fast a person walks, in meters per real second at 1x game speed; scales automatically with game speed.

items.label: Pathfinding max distance
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R10). The most a single path search will cover, in meters, before giving up.

items.label: Idle wait min
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R10). The shortest an idle person's wait can roll, in real seconds at 1x game speed.

items.label: Idle wait max
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R10). The longest an idle person's wait can roll, in real seconds at 1x game speed.

items.label: Idle wander radius
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R10). How far an idle person may wander off on their own, in meters.

items.label: Action history count
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R10). How many of a person's most recent finished actions are kept for the info window.
